# LAMMPS Input Script for SiO2 NPT Quenching

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

read_data /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat

pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 5

timestep 0.001

thermo 100

run 10000

unfix 1

write_restart quenching.restart
